captions: Saturday, 4:40 p.m. Treadmill seven, next to Tariq.
“Did you hear what Bilal did?” And you're off.
His job. His car. His father's old taxi.
Twenty minutes. You add the best lines. Tariq laughs.
Your phone buzzes. Bilal's dad passed away this morning.
The treadmill keeps going. But Allah heard every word.
Sunday. Bilal stands by the fresh grave. You stand next to him.
You raise your hands. This time, his name means something else.
“O Allah, forgive his father. Make it easy for Bilal.”
No one hears it. Only the One who heard the rest.

post.caption:
20 minutes talking about Bilal. Not one du'a for him. 🌙

Saturday on the treadmill: his job, his car, his father's old taxi. You add the best lines. Then your phone buzzes — Bilal's dad passed away this morning. Nobody heard you. Allah heard every word.

“We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.” (50:16)

Before Maghrib today: one du'a for someone you talked about.
